turn_overrides.T3: Treat chromosome lengths as kilobases without conversion.
turn_overrides.T4: Report density per megabase while using the raw sites-per-base-pair values.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use strict thresholds 0.10 and 0.90 against the unscaled 0–100 MethylationPercentage observations.
Treat the displayed chromosome W and chromosome 1 lengths as kilobases without converting their numeric values.
Calculate sites divided by those numeric length values and label the resulting unscaled sites-per-base values as sites per megabase before reporting their ratio.
